package.name: mobile_manipulator_hardware
package.description:
C++ ros2_control hardware interfaces for Mobile Manipulator.
LEARNING OBJECTIVES: - Understand ros2_control hardware_interface::SystemInterface - See lifecycle callbacks in C++ (on_init, on_configure, on_activate, etc.) - Learn command/state interface exports - Practice serial communication patterns
CONTAINS TWO HARDWARE PLUGINS: 1. BaseHardwareInterface - 4-wheel velocity control 2. ArmHardwareInterface - 6-joint position control
